title: GAMMA: GENERALIZABLE AI-GENERATED IMAGE DETECTION VIA MULTI-TASK AND MANIPULATION-AUGMENTED SUPERVISION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI-generated image detectors on out-of-distribution datasets (e.g., the GenImage benchmark and GPT-4o-generated image datasets) to measure how much the models overfit to specific generative artifacts, image storage formats, or dataset priors seen during training.
